files.adaptation: Extract the pure Enter intent resolver and types; inline the platform modifier predicate. WinOne supplies its Enter preference. IME, key-repeat, newline, queue and same-turn steer semantics are preserved. No external runtime dependency is added.
Unchanged pure follow/unpin intent helpers. WinOne wires its own scroll viewport; actual upward input cancels following, and late send acknowledgements cannot steal the reader's position.
Only TypeScript document and attachment imports change to WinOne plain text and ChatAttachment/ChatBrowserAnnotation; the snapshot/version comparison is unchanged.

hostAdaptation: The existing three-way confirmation exposes keep-editing, queued delivery and same-turn insertion. Both delivery modes share WinOne's attachment validation, pending draft, request receipt and official Pi Durable inbox. Branch reset events precede retried live replies. Existing Cindy sidebar/segmented components are composed into the user-requested fixed library views and unchanged dynamic document tabs; sidebar-source.json retains their original provenance.
